name: Danganronpa IF: The Button of Hope and the Tragic Warriors of Despair -Prologue-
source:
What if Makoto Naegi regained his memories sooner than expected? This alternate story explores Mukuro Ikusaba’s fate and the consequences of a single decision that could change the course of the Killing Game at Hope's Peak Academy.

[From [url=https://ultidev.itch.io/danganronpa-if]itch.io[/url]]
